from pathlib import Path

    insertions.append((text.index(needle), value))
add_before('"'`maxAttempts` counts'"', '- ')
add_before(' A value of "'`1`'"', '\\n-')
add_before(' Authentication errors', '\\n-')
add_before('never retried', '**')

added_ranges = []

length = 0
for position, markup in sorted(insertions):
    chunk = text[previous:position]
    parts.extend([chunk, markup])

    added_ranges.append((length, length + len(markup)))
